description: Owner correction (2026-11-10): sysmes:configst.cpk/sysmes.bin:50984 (JP 行動コマンド, battle top bar Action Commands). The PL v4.5 fix (ui-five-screens-2026-10-21.json) shortened the Polish label "Komendy akcji" -> "Akcje" (5 cells) because the 91px label hit the right screen edge; the EN side was likewise shortened from "Action Cmds" (11c) -> "Actions" (7c, v300-ui-2026-10-21-en-port.json) but stayed wider than the PL-final 5 cells. Owner: make it fit like PL — no overflow, fully translated. Shortened to "Acts" (4 cells <= PL-final 5c <= JP 12c), consistent with the v3.0 label-fit contract (config/label_fit_rules.tsv, same rule row updated). mode=grow (string pool, runtime pointer relocation): shorter string cannot crash the load; width only affects the top-bar layout.
